data.description: 【成年优香 · 山泉水波的私密失控】成年优香独自斜倚温泉石阶，湿蓝色浴巾敞开，一手遮住潮红嘴角，另一手在水下自抚，丰润大腿推动清晰水波。
data.lighting: 竹林暖色石灯笼泛光与水面波光倒影
data.promptProse: Mountain steam surrounds adult Yuuka reclining alone on broad hot-spring steps. A soaked blue wrap has fallen open across bare breasts while one thick thigh rises from the water and the other extends below it. She hides her flushed mouth with one hand and fingers herself beneath the ripples with the other, sending clear rings across the pool. Dark blue hair and eyes remain sharp against lantern light, wet lashes and embarrassed breath. Vertical bath solo portrait, no text or extra people.
